## 27-real-japanese-receipt-rectified.png

Derived from fixture 26 by `scripts/run_apple_vision_receipt_ocr.sh`. Apple Vision detects the document quadrilateral and Core Image applies perspective correction. The derived image retains the CC0 status of the source.
